title: Equipment requisitions given higher priority

paragraphs.text: Equipment left in WESTPAC in July was still missing when the warning order arrived. Requisitions had been outstanding since August; messages raised their priority, releasing many of the missing items.

researchStatus: Agent-extracted from resolved Qwen with human corrections; extraction is not a new human confirmation.
